text: After twenty years... he was replaced by A.I.
Year one. A desk, a badge, and a dream.
For twenty years, the world kept changing. And he kept showing up.
Then one morning, one email. His job would now be done by A.I.
Twenty years... packed into one cardboard box.
He started searching. So did thousands of skilled people, just like him.
But the bills never paused. The mortgage. Groceries. The kids' doctor.
Months passed. No answers. His thoughts went in circles.
One night, alone in the dark, he felt he had nothing left.
Then he remembered who he was fighting for.
His wife. His little girl. They never cared about his job title. They only needed him.
So every night, after bedtime, he learned. New skills. New tools. He built, and he grew.
Five in the morning. Every single day. Stronger in body. Stronger in mind.
Thousands applied for the same jobs. He prepared like none of them.
He heard no, again and again. Every no made him sharper.
Then one morning... another email. We'd like to offer you the role.
